coach_labels: The back foot isn't lifted properly. The hips aren't rotating. The arms are too stiff. The body isn't relaxed, which prevents the shoulders from moving and switching naturally. You're not paying attention to defense when punching.
When you throw a punch, make sure to keep your other hand up for defense.
Your punches lack accuracy, and your right hand isn't in a defensive position. You're also not rotating your hips.
